name: shadow_context_builder
description: Builds a 3D LOD1 massing model of all surrounding buildings from NYC Building Footprints. Required prerequisite for CEQR incremental shadow analysis (Chapter 8, §320): establishes the No-Action context so the project's incremental shadow can be isolated.

building_geojson.description: Project building footprint — used to derive project location if project_location is omitted.

project_location.description: [lat, lon] of project centroid. Auto-derived from building_geojson if not provided.

building_height_ft.description: Project height in feet. Used to auto-compute study area radius (4.3× height + 200 ft buffer) if study_area_radius_ft is omitted.

study_area_radius_ft.description: Radius from project site to load surrounding buildings (feet). Default: 4.3 × building_height_ft + 200 ft.

project_site_bins.description: List of BINs to exclude — buildings on the project site that will be demolished or replaced.

project_site_bbls.description: List of BBLs to exclude (alternative to project_site_bins).

context_mesh_obj.description: OBJ file content: LOD1 flat-top extrusions of all surrounding buildings. Meters, Z-up, +Y=North, origin at project centroid. Feed into shadow-incremental as no_action_mesh_obj.

context_geojson.description: 2D building footprints with height, BIN, and construction year for QA/visualization.

building_inventory.description: List of all buildings: BIN, height, height source, construction year.

data_gap_report.description: Flags: buildings with missing height data, post-2014 buildings (no LOD2), freshness note.

study_area_radius_ft.description: Radius actually used (feet) — passed through for downstream modules.

project_location.description: [lat, lon] of project site — passed through for downstream modules.

visualization.description: Folium map: surrounding buildings colored by height, study area circle, project marker.
